targets.evidence_quote: Burback (2020) empirically compared the BASC-3 TRS-C with the ASCA to assess construct validity (convergent, discriminant, divergent) since there were no published studies replicating research presented in the BASC-3 Manual. Limitations of that study included a small sample size and that most students and teachers were White. Therefore, it was important to replicate her study to overcome those limitations.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Abstract reports construct validity but does not state the original results or an overall replication verdict.
